run_dump_km_label: run the script to dump kmeans cluster labels for audio features from a feature directory
run_apply_kmeans: run the ApplyKmeans class to assign cluster labels to feature vectors using a saved kmeans model
run_get_feat_iterator: run the get_feat_iterator function to iterate over sharded numpy feature files with per-sample lengths

review_apply_kmeans_call: review the ApplyKmeans __call__ method to understand euclidean distance computation for torch tensors and numpy arrays
